policy.draft_gate: A draft is generated only when an existing primary official OKF record corroborates it or an allowlisted official page contains the normalized item name and every extracted nutrient value.
policy.stable_gate: No human:* verification is generated. All newly generated OKF documents remain draft.
policy.copyright_boundary: Article prose and images are not stored; only article metadata and factual table cells needed for source comparison are retained.
